user: close all my tabs except this one
content:
I don't have the ability to close browser tabs — that's a browser-level action outside my available tools. I can navigate, click, type, and read pages within a tab, but I can't manage the tab bar itself (open, close, or switch between tabs).

To close all tabs except this one, you can do it yourself quickly:

- **Right-click this tab** → choose **"Close other tabs"** (Chrome/Edge/Firefox all have this option).

That single click closes everything else in one go.
